SELECT
  kind,
  count(*) AS event_count,
  min(abs(quantity)) AS min_abs_qty,
  max(abs(quantity)) AS max_abs_qty,
  round(avg(abs(quantity)), 2) AS avg_abs_qty,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs(quantity)) AS median_abs_qty,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(quantity) = 1) / count(*), 1) AS pct_abs_qty_eq_1,
  sum(abs(quantity)) AS total_abs_qty
FROM stock_movements
WHERE occurred_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind
note: Used occurred_at >= 2025-01-01 and < 2026-01-01 (equivalent to the requested inclusive range) for a clean half-open bound on timestamps.
